content.text: How do I use the same Claude account for different businesses?
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: How do I use the same Claude account for different businesses?

content.text: We suggest creating different projects, one for each separate business, and creating separate Master Prompts for each business within these projects. This approach allows Claude to apply the relevant Master Prompt within each project, ensuring a clean state outside those projects.

content.text: Why English works best:
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: Why English works best:

content.text: Your AI will perform at its highest level when working in English. The business frameworks, strategic concepts, and industry knowledge that power the best AI advice are primarily developed in English. Since the entire SBE program is taught in English, keeping your Master Prompt in English also creates seamless integration with all course materials and ongoing AI interactions.
